d: Konsept tok ki is kari men do. vikas divyakirti ne sitanbar 2020 men sansad se parit hue tinon krishi kanunon ki vistrit samiksha ki hai. kya ye kanun sanvaidhanikta ki drishti se suprim kort men tik paenge; APMC tatha MSP kya hai aur in par kya vivad hai; is gatirodh ka samuchit samadhan kya ho sakta hai - in sabhi prashnon par is vidiyo men charcha ki gaee hai.
